description: This Kotlin source file defines the object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction', which contains utility methods for processing UI actions related to a canvas component within an Android application. The functions include extracting action names, sanitizing tag values, formatting agent messages, and generating JavaScript snippets for dispatching UI action status events.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a JSON object representing a user action, checking both 'name' and 'action' fields.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value to be safe for use as a tag, replacing illegal characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string containing session, surface, component, host, instance ID, and optional context JSON data for communication with a canvas.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet that dispatches a custom event indicating the success or failure status of an A2UI action.
